title: Kenyan Trout Gratin
description: A flavorful and aromatic trout dish inspired by Kenyan cuisine, topped with a creamy gratin.
instructions: 2. Season the trout fillets with salt, pepper, and Kenyan curry powder.
3. In a large skillet, heat a small amount of oil over medium heat. Cook the trout fillets for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through. Transfer the fish to a baking dish.
4. In a small bowl, mix the grated cheddar cheese and yeast (from the homemade bread packet).
5. Sprinkle the cheese mixture evenly over the cooked trout fillets.
6. Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, until the cheese is golden brown and bubbly.
7. Serve the Kenyan trout gratin hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
